title: Form Validation
description: Learn how to validate form inputs and display error messages.

data.text: **Form validation** ensures users enter correct data before submission. React makes it easy to validate inputs and provide immediate feedback.
Validate inputs on change or blur and store errors in state.

data.title: Email Validation
Registration Validation

data.text: For better UX, validate on blur (when user leaves the field) rather than on every keystroke.

data.title: Validate on Blur
Consider Form Libraries
data.text: For complex forms, consider libraries like React Hook Form or Formik. They handle validation, errors, and submission with less boilerplate.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Validate on change, blur, or submit
Display error messages near the input
Consider form libraries for complex validation
data.takeaway: Good validation improves user experience. Let's learn form submission patterns.
